title: Remove Duplicate Rows from CSV Online
metaDescription: Quickly identify and drop duplicate records from your CSV dataset using private, AST-verified Python transformations.
heading: Remove Duplicate Rows from CSV
description: Clean out exact or conditional duplicate records instantly without uploading your entire database to the cloud.
defaultPrompt: Identify and remove all duplicate rows across the entire dataset while retaining the first occurrence.

title: Trim Whitespace and Clean Text Columns in CSV
metaDescription: Strip leading, trailing, and excessive spaces from text cells in your CSV files online for free.
heading: Trim Leading & Trailing Text Spaces
description: Standardize raw string entries, eliminate rogue spaces, and fix formatting irregularities across every text column.
defaultPrompt: Trim all leading and trailing whitespace from every string column and collapse double spaces.

title: Fill Missing Values & Handle NaNs in CSV
metaDescription: Impute missing dataset numbers with median, mean, or zeros, and fill empty text columns with default markers.
heading: Fill Missing Values & Fix Empty Cells
description: Automatically impute null values, blank fields, and corrupted entries with mathematically accurate defaults.
defaultPrompt: Fill missing numeric values with 0 and replace empty text cells with 'Unknown'.

title: Standardize Date Formats in CSV to ISO-8601
metaDescription: Convert messy, mixed date strings into uniform standard ISO YYYY-MM-DD format across your CSV.
heading: Standardize CSV Date Formats
description: Harmonize disparate dates (MM/DD/YYYY, DD-MM-YYYY, textual dates) into clean, database-ready ISO strings.
defaultPrompt: Standardize all date columns to ISO format YYYY-MM-DD and drop invalid datetime rows.

title: Remove Currency Symbols and Format Numbers in CSV
metaDescription: Strip dollar signs, commas, and currency symbols to convert text price fields into numeric floats.
heading: Clean Currency Symbols & Parse Floats
description: Extract raw numeric floats from formatted financial strings containing $, €, commas, or unit symbols.
defaultPrompt: Strip all currency symbols ($/€) and commas from price columns and convert them into clean numeric float values.
